# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class SP500MomentumUniverseAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2022, 1, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)
        self.settings.seed_initial_prices = True

        # Refilter the ETF constituents monthly to match the rebalance cadence.
        self.universe_settings.filter_period = timedelta(30)
        # Select all SP500 constituents ranked by 1-year price momentum, then by dollar volume.
        self._universe = self.add_universe(self.universe.etf("SP500", universe_filter_func=lambda u: u.all(Selection.MOMENTUM, 1, Resolution.DAILY).then(lambda s: s.by_dollar_volume(10))))

        # Rebalance the portfolio monthly.
        self.schedule.on(self.date_rules.month_start('SPY'))

    def on_securities_changed(self, changes: SecurityChanges) -> None:
        if self.is_warming_up or self.time.date().day != 1:
            return
        # Create equal-weight portfolio of the universe securities.
        targets = [PortfolioTarget(s, 1./len(self._universe.selected)) for s in self._universe.selected]
        self.set_holdings(targets, liquidate_existing_holdings=True)
